fixes.what: one private part never joins a public total when the census counts per level
a count with one figure shows that figure (single-level school counts had no figure in the reply)
a count naming no ownership gives public and private both (writer rule)
a date in the question is searched in its printed forms; the writer gives the figure for that date
'which 3 LGAs' is a kind of place, not a named one (the DTM ranking route kept)
the check judges a deep analysis on its subject only
'No 2028 budget…' is not a Yes/No verdict
a dash-printed part the draft reports is stated, not missing (check prompt)
a figure-free statement draft is sent as written
drafts kept in the trace (diagnosis, no behaviour change)
the reading's LGA beats the words in the area route (Tambuwal's wards, not the state's 244)
a topic figure must carry the day asked (the 17 August 2025 dashboard, not the newest)
the 'not found' line keeps its spaces when figures are removed (wording only)
